Toshiba America Business Solutions is hiring an Associate Software Engineer I to design, implement, and unit test software based on business requirements. The role collaborates with engineering and QA teams to deliver high-quality software systems.
Manufacturing
No H1B
Responsibilities
Under close management direction, review business requirements to draft software design and review with engineering team for approval
Break down work items into tasks and provide development estimates
Implement and unit test software functions in accordance with DSE standards
Collaborate with other developers and QA team to ensure proper test coverage, resolve issues as needed to deliver high quality software systems
Regularly communicate task status to team members and identify risk areas
Perform other related duties as assigned
